queries.query: Kofu City official cadastral map parcel map GIS 甲府市
queries.result: First-party discovery found Kofu City's official こうふMAP public GIS page. The city says it publishes municipal map information including urban-planning and fixed-asset-tax road-value information, and links the public viewer; no direct parcel schema or parcel layer was established by this search.

queries.query: 甲府市 公式 地番図 公図 GIS 地籍図
queries.result: First-party Japanese discovery confirmed the official こうふMAP page and its linked Kofu public GIS viewer. The official city page also documents downloadable GIS open-data formats for some map layers, but states some map information is not downloadable. A separate official prefectural page documents the Yamanashi cadastral-survey program generally; it does not evidence a Kofu parcel service endpoint.

registry.name: こうふMAP (Kofu City public GIS)
registry.custodian: Kofu City, DX Promotion Division (甲府市 総務総室DX推進課DX推進係)
registry.scope: Kofu municipal public GIS with multiple map-information layers; a cadastral parcel layer was not confirmed in this attempt.
limitations: The city describes the system as publishing various municipal map information and says only some layers are available for open-data download.
No ownership, right-holder, address/contact, titleholder, tax/account, personal, or application fields were requested or retained.
The linked viewer was not usable for anonymous endpoint inspection in this environment because direct requests returned HTTP 403.

sourceAssessment.reasonNoSample: No safe native parcel identity, schema, CRS, or geometry was returned. The official viewer host returned HTTP 403 to bounded anonymous GET requests, and no polygon was invented or retained.
